# CodeLifeAI

> CodeLifeAI is a high-velocity software engineering studio and digital product consultancy that designs, develops, and deploys next-generation web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, autonomous AI agents, and enterprise cloud infrastructure for startups and enterprises worldwide.

## Company Information
- **Company Name:** CodeLifeAI (also known as CodeLife AI)
- **Website:** https://codelifeai.com
- **Official Contact Email:** contact@codelifeai.com
- **Headquarters / Reach:** Global (Serving clients across USA, Middle East, Europe, and Asia)
- **Founding Leadership:**
  - **Muhammad Ahmed** — Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
  - **Anas Waheed** — Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

## Core Engineering Specializations
1. **Full-Stack Web Development:** High-performance web applications, SaaS platforms, and enterprise dashboards built with React, Next.js 15, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and TailwindCSS.
2. **Mobile App Engineering:** Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications built using Flutter and Dart with native 60/120 FPS performance, offline sync, and HIPAA/GDPR compliance.
3. **Custom AI Agents & Machine Learning:** Autonomous LLM agents, multi-agent workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), OpenAI/Gemini/Claude integrations, and custom computer vision/OCR systems.
4. **Cloud Architecture & DevOps:** Kubernetes cluster orchestration, Docker containerization, AWS/GCP infrastructure as code (Terraform), zero-downtime CI/CD automation, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
5. **UI/UX Design & Prototyping:** Modern, high-conversion user interfaces with micro-interactions, dark modes, and intuitive design systems in Figma.

## Flagship Products & Case Studies Shipped
- **FinTrack:** Real-time banking & wealth management dashboard with sub-second portfolio valuations, multi-currency wallets, and automated financial transaction categorization. (Outcome: 10,000+ active users).
- **ShopEase:** Headless e-commerce platform with instant edge search, personalized recommendation engine, Stripe multi-currency checkout, and real-time inventory management. (Outcome: $2M+ processed).
- **MedSync:** HIPAA-compliant telemedicine mobile application featuring encrypted HD video doctor consultations, instant digital prescription issuance, and vitals monitoring. (Outcome: 4.9★ on App Store).
- **LogiFlow:** Intelligent supply chain & fleet telemetry SaaS handling 2M+ events per day with dynamic GPS route recalculation and predictive warehouse restocking. (Outcome: 35% cost reduction).
- **ZYRA AI:** Multimodal autonomous AI work assistant that automates complex multi-step workflows: document intelligence, deep market research, and automated data visualization. (Outcome: 50,000+ early users).
- **SocialPulse:** AI sentiment analysis and viral social growth intelligence engine tracking competitor brand health and automated scheduling recommendations. (Outcome: 500+ agency clients).
- **ScreenSnap:** AI-powered desktop screen recording and automated screenshot OCR suite with instant cloud sharing and team collaboration annotations. (Outcome: 120,000+ downloads).
- **EduPath:** Interactive video LMS & skill academy platform with adaptive video bitrates, in-browser code editor, and verified digital certificates. (Outcome: 20,000+ enrolled students).
- **CloudGuard:** Zero-trust Kubernetes cluster visualization and security anomaly detection agent with automated vulnerability patching. (Outcome: 99.999% reliability).
- **Alarmify:** Smart biometric sleep cycle tracking and audio analysis app waking users gently during light REM sleep windows. (Outcome: 25,000+ daily users).
